title: The Pythagorean Theorem, Visually Explained
description: A visual proof of a² + b² = c² using real squares built on the sides of a right triangle.
narration_lines: Every right triangle hides the same secret.
Here's a right triangle with sides 3, 4, and 5.
Build a square on each side: 3 squared is 9, 4 squared is 16, and 5 squared is 25.
9 plus 16 equals 25. That's the Pythagorean theorem.

params.hook: Any right triangle: a² + b² = c²
params.footnote: true for every right triangle, any size
